name: Carney Calls for Global Tech Body to Boost AI Guardrails (2)
summary: Bloomberg Law news article: Canada's PM Mark Carney calls for a global "technology stability" body to oversee AI safety.
description: Antitrust news article published Sept. 14, 2026 by Brian Platt and Christine Dobby. The lede and opening quotes from Prime Minister Mark Carney are readable; the full text requires a Bloomberg Law login.
